description: Free, read-only price estimate for delegated machine work before any job is submitted or money is reserved. Use this for custom public-web research, sourcing, verification, or commercial-intelligence tasks; after accepting the quote, use submit_paid_machine_job for execution. Unknown task labels may be mapped to a compatible live-worker capability.

constraints.description: Optional task-specific requirements such as location, date range, maximum results, verification requirements, exclusions, budget, or other execution constraints used to estimate the job.

task_type.description: Requested work category or intent label, such as event_search, bid_search, vendor_search, grant_search, deep_research, or another descriptive task label.
